name: Andaz Delhi
positioning: Art-filled Hyatt lifestyle hotel in Aerocity, New Delhi, minutes from Indira Gandhi International Airport
best_for: Travelers who want a stylish base close to Delhi's international airport
Guests who enjoy contemporary design and local art
Travelers bringing a dog or cat

facts.text: The hotel is in Aerocity, about 7 minutes from Indira Gandhi International Airport.
The Dwarka Expressway tunnel gives direct access to Gurugram, Dwarka and Yashobhoomi.
The hotel offers convenient access to Vasant Kunj and the diplomatic enclave of Chanakyapuri.
The hotel is well connected by Metro Rail.
Standard rooms have a daybed for looking out over the pool and the courtyard.
Runway View and Deluxe rooms include a complimentary non-alcoholic minibar stocked with regional selections.
Deluxe rooms include access to social hours at the Andaz Lounge.
The hotel has a pool, a spa and a fitness centre.
Soul Pantry's menu draws on India's traditional grains and is led by an all-women culinary team.
Dogs and cats are welcome, and a bed, food bowl and food are provided for them during the stay.
Valet parking and self-parking are complimentary.
The hotel hosts weddings and has multiple meeting venues.

highlights.text: The hotel reflects Delhi's creative spirit through 401 art pieces inspired by the city's culture and stories.
Each guest room is decorated with locally inspired details and holds one of 401 unique artworks inspired by Delhi.
Runway View rooms look out over the runway as aircraft climb into the sky.
The Andaz suites have a separate living area and a bathroom with a walk-in shower and a fast-fill bathtub.
AnnaMaya, the all-day restaurant, fills a two-level space that overlooks the pool.

considerations.text: Runway views come with the Runway View rooms and the View Suites, so guests who want to watch the aircraft should book one of those.
WhataHotel notes that airport proximity may bring occasional aircraft noise.
WhataHotel notes limited walkable attractions in the immediate Aerocity area.
